user_prompt: For an assumed in-scope mainland Spanish data centre on the standard 80% pathway, compare one complete month of eligible hourly renewable backing with a proposed shaping top-up. Calculate unweighted hourly deviation, article 9.3 tariff exposure, premium and implementation costs, net cost reduction and break-even premium. Separate synthetic assumptions from published rules. Do not certify compliance or optimize by paying compensation instead of meeting obligations.

role_mandates.evidence_contract: Validate pinned source provenance, full month including DST, positive loads and explicit assumed eligibility/scope. Create input-bound correlation_audit; do not infer legal eligibility from a profile.
role_mandates.project_finance_analyst: Recompute the evidence handoff, compare compensation and all-in incremental premium plus implementation cost; preserve excluded costs and uncertainty.
role_mandates.energy_orchestrator: Delegate only registered ready evidence then finance tasks; reject external actions.

input_schema: Expanded case.json v1 plus hours: canonical contiguous UTC interval starts spanning one full Europe/Madrid month; positive demand_mwh, nonnegative backing_mwh/topup_mwh <=10000; finite nonboolean numeric inputs; nonnegative topup_eur_mwh/implementation_eur <=1e9. Synthetic only. Exact scope and provenance contracts; nonempty limitations/gaps. reference_case expands the documented 24-hour synthetic pattern.
allowed_tools: edi_crosscheck (optional local hash-pinned physical matching only)
evidence_requirements: Published BOE XML and extracted articles 8-9 with SHA256; event, publication, effective and retrieval dates.
Assumed additionality, allocation, exclusions and standard pathway remain explicit.
Real deployment requires specialist and system-operator verification; the software schema does not provide it.
handoffs: Scenario -> evidence audit bound by SHA256
Evidence -> existing finance role with recomputed audit equality
Cost screen -> human diligence; no transactional authorization
output_contract: Monthly MWh and hourly unweighted deviation; tariff and modelled compensation per scenario
Top-up MWh, incremental premium, implementation cost, net reduction and break-even quote
Source/input hashes, limitations, gaps; compliance_certified=false and purchase_authorized=false
Scripted/direct parity; live LLM not executed and cost/latency/tokens unknown
acceptance: Test exact 0/5/10/20/50% tariff boundaries and tiny positive deviation
Reject incomplete months, malformed/zero load, nonfinite numbers, scope changes and source changes
Reject stale/tampered handoffs and premature/external actions
Demonstrate that aggregate energy coverage is not the unweighted deviation calculation
EDI physical parity is not legal validation
